result.brief: 提出跨模态模型与策略路由的统一框架与理论，构建含视频生成与机器人操作的评测矩阵，量化路由在质量-成本权衡下的收益。
result.reason: Studies routing among specialized models/policies across modalities including video generation and robot manipulation, but contributes orchestration theory and benchmarks rather than world models or representations.
